ddl.value: platform_fee_minor is null or (platform_fee_minor >= 0 and platform_fee_minor <= amount_minor)
ddl.name: payment_platform_fee_check

ddl.value: paypal_fee_minor is null or (paypal_fee_minor >= 0 and paypal_fee_minor <= amount_minor)
ddl.name: payment_paypal_fee_check

ddl.value: balance_minor >= 0 or not (starts_with(account, 'client_held:') or starts_with(account, 'owed:') or starts_with(account, 'paid_out:') or account = 'client_refunds')
ddl.name: ledger_balance_non_negative_check

ddl.value: ("sent_minor" is null and "fee_estimate_minor" is null) or ("sent_minor" > 0 and "fee_estimate_minor" >= 0 and "sent_minor" + "fee_estimate_minor" = "amount_minor")
ddl.name: payout_request_sent_check
